about: This repository's reliability checklist. The code review reads it from the base commit (.github/code-review.ts), matches each item's trigger against the PR's diff (.github/review-checklist.ts) and checks only the matched items; a failed check is a P1 finding. Add an item for a failure that happened here and could happen again. Each item: id; trigger (paths: globs such as "src/db/**"; lines: a regex over the changed lines of a matching file; both set means both); check (what must be true, one or two sentences); why (the incident, PR or issue behind it). Example: {"id": "migration-at-start", "trigger": {"paths": ["migrations/**"]}, "check": "The migration runs at startup and is forward-only.", "why": "#12"}
